script.text: Reporter Carly Carmine was on the trail to find out what exactly the Crimson Dragon was.
Her search led her to sneak into Arcadia Movement headquarters, where she came face to face with Sayer.
These files prove Arcadia Movement isn't as innocent as they claim to be!
You should be more careful. You shouldn’t go scampering where there could be traps.
Now that you’ve seen what you’ve seen, I can’t let you leave.
But in the interest of good sport, allow me to at least give you a fighting chance.
You can try to run, or you can duel me. What do you say?
You should have tried to run.
